_note: The ONE place to retime the film. Edit the scene 'start' values (seconds) to the measured voice-over timings, then re-run _work/capture.cjs and _work/encode.sh. Every animation is keyed as an offset from its scene start; 'end' is informational (a scene ends where the next starts). 'items' in the 'require' scene are the offsets at which its three items begin to appear. Starts are ESTIMATES until the audio is measured.
